description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Targets 1 creature you can see

Name the target aloud and say one thing you will do to it before the end of your next turn: Strike it, Trip it, Shove it, Grapple it, or Disarm it. Until the end of your next turn you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and checks made to do that thing to that creature. If the target can hear and understand you, it heard the contract: it is frightened 1. If the end of your next turn comes and you have not done what you said, the wasteland heard you too: you take a −1 status penalty to attack rolls until the end of the turn after that.

cinderfall.incomplete: Three independent blockers: (1) the +1 bonus needs a predicate scoped to 'against the one specific creature I verbally named this turn' -- no roll option identifies an arbitrary, per-use-chosen target creature (real target-scoped predicates are trait/role-based, e.g. target:trait:X, never a specific individual creature chosen at the table). (2) The frightened-on-hearing clause has no automated condition-application analog (even a real save-based fear feat, Scare to Death, only ships Note flavor-text rule elements, never a rule element that actually applies the condition). (3) The delayed self-penalty for not following through requires tracking a mid-scene 'promise' over time with no rule-element equivalent anywhere.
